message.content: The type predicate `v is string` doesn't work with string enum values since TypeScript infers the array type as the enum type. Let me fix the test file:

function.name: str_replace_editor

extras.diff:
--- /tmp/gestalt/phase/63ff1071-5533-4487-9cf5-cd66e5b8b64e/1/tests/unit/shared/types/index.test.ts
+++ /tmp/gestalt/phase/63ff1071-5533-4487-9cf5-cd66e5b8b64e/1/tests/unit/shared/types/index.test.ts
@@ -20,3 +20 @@
-    const values = Object.values(LeaveRequestStatus).filter(
-      (v): v is string => typeof v === 'string',
-    );
+    const values = Object.values(LeaveRequestStatus);
